title.en: "I Love You" and Auto Memoir Dolls
title.fr: "Je t`aime" et la poupée de souvenirs automatiques
title.es: Te quiero y la muñeca de recuerdos automáticos

1.overview: Hodgins retrieves Violet from the hospital, as Major Gilbert asked him to look out for her. After they meet Gilbert's relatives, he offers her a job.
1.summary:
Hodgins retrieves Violet from the hospital, as Major Gilbert asked him to look out for her. After they meet Gilbert`s relatives, he offers her a job.
Source: netflix

2.overview: Violet tries to adjust to her new job: she needs to learn typing, and her coworkers question whether she has the right demeanor for letter writing.
2.summary:
Violet tries to adjust to her new job: she needs to learn typing, and her coworkers question whether she has the right demeanor for letter writing.
Source: netflix

title.ja: 「あなたが, 良き自動手記人形になりますように」
title.en: May You Be an Exemplary Auto Memoir Doll
title.fr: Puissiez-vous être une poupée de souvenirs automatique exemplaire
title.es: Que puedas convertirte en una buena muñeca de recuerdos automáticos
title.ko: 「당신이, 좋은 자동 수기 인형이 될 수 있기를」
title.pl: Obyś była wspaniałą lalką zapisującą myśli
title.x-jat: "Anata ga, Yoki Jidou Shuki Ningyou ni Narimasu You ni"

3.overview: Violet enrolls in a Doll training course. Her classmate Luculia befriends her, though she has her own problems with her war veteran brother.
3.summary:
Violet enrolls in a Doll training course. Her classmate Luculia befriends her, though she has her own problems with her war veteran brother.
Source: netflix

title.ja: 「君は道具ではなく, その名が似合う人になるんだ」
title.en: Don`t Be a Tool, Become Someone That Matches with Their Name
title.fr: Ne sois pas un outil, deviens ce que représente ton prénom
title.es: No eres una herramienta; te convertirás en alguien digno de ese nombre
title.ko: 「넌 도구가 아니라, 그 이름에 맞는 사람이 되는 거야」
title.pl: Nie będziesz narzędziem, ale osobą godną tego imienia
title.x-jat: "Kimi wa Dougu de wa Naku, Sono Na ga Niau Hito ni Narunda"

4.overview: When Iris goes to her home village on an assignment, Violet accompanies her. Iris's birthday party sparks a disagreement with her family.
4.summary:
When Iris goes to her home village on an assignment, Violet accompanies her. Iris`s birthday party sparks a disagreement with her family.
Source: netflix

title.en: You Write Letters That Bring People Together?
title.fr: Tu écris des lettres qui rassemblent les gens?
title.es: ¿Escribes cartas que unen a las personas?
title.x-jat: "Hito o Musubu Tegami o Kaku no ka?"

5.overview: Princess Charlotte is to have a public correspondence with her betrothed, and Violet is entrusted with writing the letters on her highness’s behalf.
5.summary:
Princess Charlotte is to have a public correspondence with her betrothed, and Violet is entrusted with writing the letters on her highness’s behalf.
Source: netflix

title.fr: Quelque part sous un ciel étoilé

6.overview: Violet travels to the country of Astrea to work with transcribers copying damaged manuscripts. Her partner Leon has a past not unlike hers.
6.summary:
Violet travels to the country of Astrea to work with transcribers copying damaged manuscripts. Her partner Leon has a past not unlike hers.
Source: netflix

7.overview: A playwright with writer's block and a tragic past summons Violet to the country of Genetrix to help him finish a script. They both learn about grief.
7.summary:
A playwright with writer`s block and a tragic past summons Violet to the country of Genetrix to help him finish a script. They both learn about grief.
Source: netflix

8.overview: Violet learns that Major Gilbert is listed as missing in action, but his family members think he is dead. Unable to cope, she remembers the war.
8.summary:
Violet learns that Major Gilbert is listed as missing in action, but his family members think he is dead. Unable to cope, she remembers the war.
Source: netflix

title.ja: 「ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン」

9.overview: Heartbroken, Violet withdraws from her job and questions whether she even has the right to be an Auto Memory Doll. Then, she receives a letter.
9.summary:
Heartbroken, Violet withdraws from her job and questions whether she even has the right to be an Auto Memory Doll. Then, she receives a letter.
Source: netflix

title.ja: 「愛する人は ずっと見守っている」
title.en: A Loved One Will Always Watch Over You
title.fr: Un être cher veillera toujours sur vous
title.es: La persona amada siempre te está observando
title.pl: Ukochani zawsze będą nad tobą czuwać
title.x-jat: "Ai Suru Hito wa Zutto Mimamotte Iru"

10.overview: Violet travels to a countryside mansion to write letters for a war widow, but her young daughter Ann resents her presence.
10.summary:
Violet travels to a countryside mansion to write a letter for a gravely ill war widow, but her young daughter Ann resents Violet`s presence.
Source: netflix

title.ja: 「もう, 誰も死なせたくない」
title.en: I Don`t Want Anybody Else to Die
title.es: Ya no quiero que nadie muera
title.ko: 「더 이상 아무도 죽게 두고 싶지 않아」
title.pl: Nie chcę znowu patrzeć, jak ktoś umiera

11.overview: Against Hodgins' wishes, Violet takes a job from a soldier at a military base in Ctrigall, a former enemy nation now engulfed in civil war.
11.summary:
Against Hodgins` wishes, Violet takes a job from a soldier at a military base in Ctrigall, a former enemy nation now engulfed in civil war.
Source: netflix

12.overview: The Major's older brother is ordered to defend the signing ceremony from former Gardarik forces opposed to peace.
12.summary:
The Major`s older brother is ordered to defend the signing ceremony from former Gardarik forces opposed to peace. Violet intercepts his train.
Source: netflix
